marks.gloss_en: תא שמע: רבי יוחנן אמר כל זמן שיונק, ואם איתא -- 'והוא שיונק' מיבעי ליה! שמע מינה -- R' Yochanan's wording fits only horn A
ואם איתא -- 'והוא שיונק' מיבעי ליה: on horn B R' Yochanan added a condition, and he would have said 'and provided it suckles', not 'as long as it suckles'
דתניא: ... אחד עור הראש של עגל הרך ... משום רבי יעקב / משום רבי שמעון -- the calf's-head hide counted as flesh is taught in the names of single tannaim

the baraita: one who slaughters a burnt-offering intending to burn an olive-bulk of the hide beneath the tail outside its place -- unfit, and no karet; outside its time -- piggul, and one is liable to karet for it
אמר ליה: לימדתנו רבינו, אלו שעורותיהן כבשרן -- ועור הראש של עגל הרך! you taught us the mishna that lists the calf's-head hide as like flesh (kind tnan under protest: the formula is לימדתנו, not תנן)
אמר ליה: אל תקניטני, בלשון יחיד אני שונה אותה (= p_ry_bilshon_yachid_egel)
R' Yochanan: do not trouble me -- I teach it [the mishna's calf's-head clause] in the language of a single [sage]
horn B: or perhaps Ulla means within its first year, whether it suckles or not; and R' Yochanan told him: within its first year AND provided it suckles
R' Yochanan, asked whether the hide of the head of a tender calf imparts impurity: it does not impart impurity

R' Yaakov / R' Shimon: whether the hide of the hooves, the hide of the head of a tender calf, the hide beneath the tail, or all that the Sages listed for impurity as 'whose hide is like their flesh' -- to include the hide of the genitals -- outside its place: unfit, no karet; outside its time: piggul, with karet (122b.8)
from the mishna's 'or walked on them': walked -- yes; did not walk -- no
הילך אין, לא הילך לא? והא תני רבי חייא: אוזן חמור שטלאה לקופתו טהורה -- טלאה, אף על גב דלא הילך!
the mishna: all of them that one tanned, or walked on them the time needed for tanning, are pure
והא תני רבי חייא: אוזן חמור שטלאה לקופתו טהורה -- טלאה, אף על גב דלא הילך: sewn, it is pure though not trodden upon
לא: טלאה; הילך -- אין, לא הילך -- לא -- [the ear] was sewn; [of a skin spread out:] walked on, yes; not walked on, no
לא: טלאה, הילך -- אין, לא הילך -- לא: no -- [R' Chiyya's case is] sewn; [the mishna's hides:] trodden upon, yes, not trodden upon, no
how much is 'the time needed for tanning'? [the time to walk] four mil
for a kneader -- [four mil]
and for prayer -- four mil
the mishna: [among those whose hide is like their flesh is] the hide of the hooves
'hatteme'im' -- to include their hides as their flesh
the mishna: [among those whose hide is like their flesh are] the hide of the gecko, the koach, the lizard and the skink -- the chameleon is not listed
והא אלה אכולהו כתיבי -- but 'eleh' is written over all of them, so it cannot single out some
Rav: 'lemineihu' interrupted the matter (= p_rav_leminehu_hifsik)
Rav: 'after its kind' (lemineihu) interrupted the matter
ולחשוב נמי תנשמת -- then let it count the chameleon too
Rav is a tanna, and he teaches the chameleon (= p_rav_tanna_hu, p_rav_or_tinshemet)
Rav Shmuel bar Yitzchak: Rav has the standing of a tanna
והא תנא דידן לא תני תנשמת -- but our tanna does not teach the chameleon
our tanna holds like R' Yehuda, who goes by texture (= p_tanna_didan_kerabbi_yehuda, p_ry_azil_batar_gishta)
Rav Sheshet b. R' Idi: our tanna holds like R' Yehuda
the baraita: one might think [the inclusion covers] all of them; the verse says 'eleh' [-- not all]
and [our tanna and R' Yehuda] disagree about the texture of the lizard
